page_title: JUV 0-1 UDI | Juventus v Udinese 12/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Rosario Abisso shows the yellow card to Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) for a heavy challenge.

90+1' The corner lands on the head of Weston McKennie (Juventus) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90' Bremer (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' The free kick into the penalty area from Alex Sandro (Juventus) is cleared.
89' Isaac Success (Udinese) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
84' Substitution. Andrea Cambiaso leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leonardo Cerri (Juventus).
82' The foul by Walace (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Rosario Abisso.
81' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and it's Alex Sandro (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
79' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isaac Success (Udinese) comes onto the pitch so that Lorenzo Lucca can be given a rest.
77' A substitution has been made. Florian Thauvin goes off and Brenner (Udinese) comes on.
77' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) replaces Manuel Locatelli.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Chiesa departs the field of play to be replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

75' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
74' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Rosario Abisso ignores the protests.
74' Walace (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
73' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
72' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
71' Alex Sandro (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
68' Rosario Abisso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alex Sandro (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Zemura will be replaced by Festy Ebosele (Udinese).
65' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue will be replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Timothy Weah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) thought he had scored but it was disallowed as the ball ran out of play in the build up.
58' Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
58' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
56' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
54' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
52' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
50' The free kick is taken by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), but ball is cleared.
49' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
43' Alex Sandro (Juventus) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
42' Maduka Okoye makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) after a cross from the side. Juventus have a corner.

41' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
41' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
40' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close! The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Bremer (Juventus), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
38' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
36' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
36' Rosario Abisso blows for a foul after Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Juventus win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
35' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes it short.
33' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
31' The game is interrupted now, Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Andrea Cambiaso plays a short pass through to Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

28' Federico Gatti (Juventus) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Maduka Okoye was alert and the score remains the same.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.

25' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) darts to the edge of the box to meet the ball from the free kick and sends a header towards the middle of the target. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it.
24' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alex Sandro (Juventus) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.

23' Wasted effort! Timothy Weah (Juventus) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
23' A dangerous looking corner kick from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is cleared to safety by the defence.
22' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
21' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a chip pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye is quickest to intercept the ball.
19' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Federico Gatti (Juventus) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
18' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
18' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the corner with a short pass.
16' Udinese take a short corner kick.
15' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) whips in a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye is well positioned and punches the ball away.
14' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
12' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
10' Today's referee Rosario Abisso rightly decides to book Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for his harsh tackle.
10' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

9' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.

7' That didn't go as planned! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Maduka Okoye, who easily kept it out.
7' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
6' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find Weston McKennie, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
4' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.
3' Alex Sandro (Juventus) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a throw-in.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
